subject.title: Cron session accumulation can silently exhaust agent context window — no guardrails or warnings

question: Should this issue remain the umbrella while the open retention and cadence PRs are reviewed, and should OpenClaw core accept the proposed cron cleanup and cadence-guardrail semantics?
rationale: The retention bug is source-backed, but the complete request spans compatibility-sensitive session cleanup plus a new operator-facing scheduling policy that automation should not choose unilaterally.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Linked PRs Settle
options.body: Track the combined user problem here while maintainers review the guarded retention cleanup and configurable cadence guardrail, then split only verified leftovers after those decisions land.

options.title: Split Remaining Work Now
options.body: Create separate canonical issues for retention cleanup, cadence policy, context warnings, and session cleanup before narrowing or closing this umbrella.

options.title: Reject Core Cadence Policy
options.body: Keep the retention bug path open but explicitly close or narrow the high-frequency cadence-guardrail slice if core should not own that policy.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until Linked PRs Settle
